description: One invoice line in Speedy Onboard's canonical shape. Money, quantities and prices are decimal strings, never JSON numbers. See canonical/FORMAT.md for the CSV representation.

brand_manufacturer.description: The manufacturer whose brand the item carries.
brand_manufacturer.title: Brand Manufacturer

anyOf.description: A decimal string in pounds, at most 3 fractional digits.

catch_weight_lbs.description: Actual pounds shipped for a variable-weight item. Null for an item that is not catch-weight; missing on a catch-weight item is a readiness failure.
catch_weight_lbs.title: Catch Weight Lbs

customer_id.description: The bill-to account of record. Not the ship-to: a rebate follows the customer who was billed.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

anyOf.description: A decimal string with at most 4 fractional digits.

deviated_price.description: The deviated price, when is_deviated is true. Null otherwise.
deviated_price.title: Deviated Price

ext_amount.description: Extended line amount. Should equal qty x unit_price within tolerance.
ext_amount.title: Ext Amount

invoice_no.description: The distributor's invoice number, as printed.
invoice_no.title: Invoice No

invoice_vendor.description: Who the distributor bought from on this line. Differs from brand_manufacturer when a redistributor is in the middle, which is a common cause of rebate misattribution.
invoice_vendor.title: Invoice Vendor

is_deviated.description: Whether this line was sold at a deviated (contract) price rather than list.
is_deviated.title: Is Deviated

mfr_item_code.description: The manufacturer's item or part code.
mfr_item_code.title: Mfr Item Code

pack_size.description: Eaches per case. Required to compare a per-case rebate against an each-priced line; null when the distributor does not supply it.
pack_size.title: Pack Size

qty.description: Quantity shipped, in the line's unit of measure.
qty.title: Qty

uom.description: Unit of measure: CS, EA or LB.
uom.title: Uom

title: Canonical invoice line
